triples.tail_surface: cap or bonnet pointed toward the suction side of the pump
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 阀盖或阀帽指向泵吸入口侧
triples.evidence_text: Internal type relief valves mounted on Viking pumps should always have the cap or bonnet pointed toward the suction side of the pump.

triples.tail_surface: mounted on the discharge side of the pump
triples.evidence_text: Return-to-tank type relief valves should always be mounted on the discharge side of the pump.
If pump rotation is reversed, change the relief valve.

triples.tail_surface: Turn the internal type end for end
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 将内置式安全阀调头安装
triples.evidence_text: Turn the internal type end for end; move the return-to-tank type to the other port.

triples.tail_surface: move the return-to-tank type to the other port
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 将回油箱式安全阀移至另一接口
triples.evidence_text: Turn the internal type end for end; move the return-to-tank type to the other port.

triples.tail_surface: pressure protection must be provided on both sides of the pump for both rotations
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在泵两侧为两种转向均提供压力保护
triples.evidence_text: If on a particular installation rotation is reversed, e.g., using one pump to fill a tank, and then by use of a reversing switch or other means of changing the rotation to permit the same pump to circulate the liquid through a heater or to load out, then pressure protection must be provided on both sides of the pump for both rotations.

triples.head_surface: Pumps or systems without relief valves
triples.head_canonical_zh: 未装安全阀的泵或系统
triples.tail_surface: some form of pressure protection, e.g. torque limiting devices or rupture disks
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 某种形式的压力保护（如扭矩限制装置或爆破片）
triples.evidence_text: Pumps or systems without relief valves should have some form of pressure protection, e.g. torque limiting devices or rupture disks.

triples.head_surface: discharge line is blocked or closed
triples.tail_surface: pressure can build up until the motor stalls, the drive equipment fails, a pump part breaks or ruptures, or the piping bursts
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 压力升高直至电机堵转、驱动设备故障、泵零件断裂或破裂或管路爆裂
triples.evidence_text: If there is no place for this liquid to go, i.e. the discharge line is blocked or closed, pressure can build up until the motor stalls, the drive equipment fails, a pump part breaks or ruptures, or the piping bursts.

triples.tail_surface: some form of pressure protection must be used
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 必须使用某种形式的压力保护
triples.evidence_text: Because of this, some form of pressure protection must be used with a positive displacement pump.
The pressure relief valve mounted on most Viking pumps and most in-line valves are of the spring-loaded poppet design. See Figure A4.
